citations.quote: George Calvelo, ABS-CBN News MANILA ( 2nd UPDATE ) — Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Tuesday stood by his claim that former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque's asylum application in Austria had been denied, challenging Roque to prove otherwise.

MANILA, Philippines (First published Sept. 15, 8 p.m.) — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Tuesday claimed that former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque's asylum bid in Austria had been denied, a claim Roque later disputed.
"By the way, na-deny 'yung asylum ni Harry Roque," Remulla said.
“By the way, tapos na ’yung asylum, na-deny ’yung asylum ni Harry Roque. Tapos na ’yung five months. Kung may red notice na, kukunin ko siya,” pahayag ni Remulla.
